item.title: Lu Dort addresses trade to Hawks
item.description: Clemente Almanza: Luguentz Dort on getting traded to the Hawks: "It's amazing. Obviously, Nickeil [Alexander-Walker] is one of my closest friends. Played on the same team with Nickeil in high school and against him our whole life, obviously. When I got the call and I knew I was heading there, I hit him right away. I was really happy. He's helped me out throughout this whole transition and with their style of play. I'm glad that I got a guy like him on my team now."
